name: Tuscan Pointe Farm
tagline: Link to Tuscan Pointe Farm Facebook Page at https://www.facebook.com/tuscanpointefarm/
description: Tuscan Pointe Farm is an independent pumpkin patch in 170 Rivervista Drive, AL. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with picking through spring, summer, autumn, and winter. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Mar – Jun in this growing zone.
